prose: WP01 re-implementation complete after review v1 requested changes. All seven acceptance gates green. Every Issue 1-3, 4, 6, 8, 10 from the v1 review addressed with TDD-disciplined commits on the WP branch: red test (2463d30) -> green refactor (97241b9) -> conformance suite (e6e1902) -> tooling (89ded3e) -> spec fix (7d0116b) -> coverage hole fix (bdd89ef).

files_created.description: Canonical RetrievedChunk entity, moved from domain/answering/entities.py. Carries the similarity clamp validator and a from_chunk factory.

23-test port-conformance suite: isinstance + signature match + failure injection for all eight ports. Includes the M1/M2 (FakePageScraper.fail_next -> SourcePageUnreachable) and M6 (FakeVectorStore.fail_next -> VectorStoreUnavailable) TDD targets. Single source of truth that fakes can stand in for the production adapters (plan Phase 0.5 § E checklist item 2).
Tests for RetrievedChunk.from_chunk factory + similarity clamp on direct construction.
TDD red-phase record: VectorStore.query must return list[RetrievedChunk]. Now green after the 97241b9 refactor.

files_modified.description: VectorStore.query return type changed from list[Chunk] to list[RetrievedChunk]. All five Protocols decorated with @runtime_checkable.
All three Protocols (Retriever, LowConfidencePolicy, AnswerGenerator) decorated with @runtime_checkable. RetrievedChunk now imported from ..shared.retrieval.
RetrievedChunk re-imported from ..shared.retrieval. Local definition and validator deleted.
Re-exports RetrievedChunk alongside the existing exception hierarchy.
FakeVectorStore.query now returns list[RetrievedChunk] with similarity populated deterministically from chunk_id. fail_next -> VectorStoreUnavailable (M6).
Import updated to use ..shared.retrieval.RetrievedChunk. No behaviour change.
Added fail_under = 90 under [tool.coverage.report]. Added [tool.importlinter] skeleton (root_package = 'support_bot', contracts = []) so WP05 can extend with the concrete layer-dependency contracts.
FR-009 wording corrected: 'LowConfidencePolicy.handle port' replaced with 'LowConfidencePolicy port (with should_refuse / refusal_message methods)' to align with plan § Phase 0.5.

test_results.command: cd .worktrees/001-customer-support-rag-agent-WP01 && uv run pytest tests/domain tests/fakes -q

validator.command: spec-bridge-skill-tool implement WP01 -f 001-customer-support-rag-agent (one review-status gate deferred to spec-bridge-review)
